# Vendored db-skills text

The `SKILL.md` of every skill the PostgreSQL rules enforce, copied verbatim from
[db-skills](https://github.com/rafapeixer/db-skills) at the commit in `REF` (the
same commit `src/evidence.ts` pins for the evidence links). The optional LLM
explainer sends this text as cached context, from inside the client's runner, so
the explanation quotes the same position and numbers the rule does.

`scripts/validate.sh` checks that these files match the pinned commit when the
sister repository is available. db-skills is MIT licensed; see each file's
origin repository for the license text.
